newsitem.title: UK: SFO copper investigation continues in UK.
newsitem.headline: SFO copper investigation continues in UK.

text.p: There is no change in the status of the investigation being carried out by Britain's Serious Fraud Office (SFO) into the copper scandal following the latest developments in Tokyo.
"Our position is unchanged. The investigation continues, and we are liaising with the Japanese authorities," an SFO spokesman said on Tuesday.
In Tokyo earlier on Tuesday, Sumitomo Corp alleged that its former head trader Yasuo Hamanaka committed fraud in connection with a $2.6 billion trading scandal.

Sumitomo alleged that Hamanaka committed fraud through a newly disclosed Hong Kong connection. Tokyo prosecutors then issued formal indictments against Hamanaka on four counts of forgery, the crime for which he was arrested three weeks ago.

Sumitomo's latest complaint states that in 1994 Hamanaka fraudulently raised $770 million through a Hong Kong subsidiary of Sumitomo, under the false pretext of purchasing copper warrants, in order to cover losses from unauthorised futures deals.
